title: VRPRM: Process Reward Modeling via Visual Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2508.03556v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Process Reward Models (PRMs) provide fine-grained supervision over intermediate reasoning steps, yet most existing models lack long-range reasoning and deep thinking capabilities. Although prior work has introduced Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to reward models, the high annotation cost of CoT-PRM still limits its scalability. To address these challenges, we propose the Visual Reasoning Process Reward Model (VRPRM) and design a label-efficient two-stage training strategy. Experimental results demonstrate that with only 5.5K CoT-PRM supervised step labels and 40K non-CoT PRM reinforcement learning training examples, VRPRM achieves a macro F1 score of 69.18 on VisualProcessBench, outperforming VisualPRM-8B, a non-thinking PRM trained on 400K examples, by 7.00 points. translated_title: VRPRM：基于视觉推理的过程奖励建模
translated_abstract: 过程奖励模型（PRM）为中间推理步骤提供细粒度的监督，然而大多数现有模型缺乏长程推理和深度思考能力。尽管先前的工作已将思维链引入奖励模型，但CoT-PRM高昂的标注成本仍然限制了其可扩展性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了视觉推理过程奖励模型（VRPRM），并设计了一种标签高效的两阶段训练策略。实验结果表明，仅使用5.5K个CoT-PRM监督步骤标签和40K个非CoT PRM强化学习训练样本，VRPRM在VisualProcessBench上取得了69.18的宏F1分数，超过基于40万样本训练的非思考型PRM——VisualPRM-8B达7.00分。在Best-of-N评估中，VRPRM-RL分别为InternVL2.5-8B、26B和38B策略模型带来21.77、23.42和23.12分的绝对Overall提升，最高提升可达……
tldr: VRPRM提出了一种标签高效的两阶段训练策略，仅用5.5K个CoT标注和40K个强化学习样本就实现了更优的过程奖励建模，在VisualProcessBench上超越基于40万样本训练的VisualPRM-8B达7分，并在Best-of-N评估中为不同规模的多模态策略模型带来超过21分的性能提升。
en_tdlr: VRPRM introduces a label-efficient two-stage training strategy that achieves superior process reward modeling with only 5.5K CoT labels and 40K RL examples, outperforming VisualPRM-8B (trained on 400K samples) by 7 points on VisualProcessBench and bringing over 21-point improvements to multimodal policy models in Best-of-N evaluation.
